title: Investigating Business in a Competitive Environment

questions.question: Assess two reasons why the demand for holidays is typically income elastic.
questions.modelAnswer: Holidays are generally luxury discretionary goods. When consumer disposable incomes rise, demand increases disproportionately; conversely, in economic downturns, bookings drop sharply as households cut non-essential spending.
questions.reasoning: Award 2 marks for knowledge of YED, 2 marks for application to travel markets, and 4 marks for analytical chains of reasoning regarding income shifts.
